# U-shaped profile dimensions
width = 70  # mm
height = 40  # mm
web_thickness = 5  # mm
length = 450  # mm

# Calculate the positions and sizes for the three blocks that form the U-shape
# We'll create the U-shape using one main block and subtract two blocks

# Main block (full rectangle)
main_block_x = 0
main_block_y = 0
main_block_z = 0
main_block_x_size = width
main_block_y_size = length
main_block_z_size = height

# Left cutout block (to create the left side of the U)
left_cutout_x = web_thickness
left_cutout_y = 0
left_cutout_z = web_thickness
left_cutout_x_size = (width - 2 * web_thickness) / 2
left_cutout_y_size = length
left_cutout_z_size = height - web_thickness

# Right cutout block (to create the right side of the U)
right_cutout_x = web_thickness + left_cutout_x_size
right_cutout_y = 0
right_cutout_z = web_thickness
right_cutout_x_size = (width - 2 * web_thickness) / 2
right_cutout_y_size = length
right_cutout_z_size = height - web_thickness

print(f"Main block: x={main_block_x}, y={main_block_y}, z={main_block_z}")
print(f"Main block size: x_size={main_block_x_size}, y_size={main_block_y_size}, z_size={main_block_z_size}")
print(f"\nLeft cutout: x={left_cutout_x}, y={left_cutout_y}, z={left_cutout_z}")
print(f"Left cutout size: x_size={left_cutout_x_size}, y_size={left_cutout_y_size}, z_size={left_cutout_z_size}")
print(f"\nRight cutout: x={right_cutout_x}, y={right_cutout_y}, z={right_cutout_z}")
